audit.whatIsWrong: Page rated the lane 7.5/10 difficulty while the mirror audit settled it at 4/10 from Karma's side.
audit.why: Ratings must be inverse across the two directions or mirror-fix.js overwrites this page.
audit.corrected: diffRating 6/10, and the two prose lines that quote the number updated to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with the already-audited Karma page on rows 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6.
audit.why: The mirror set Karma / Karma / Karma / Karma / Tryndamere / Karma / Tryndamere. Level 6 is Tryndamere's — Undying Rage is his only spike and Mantra has been available to Karma since level 1, so 6 is not a Karma spike at all.
audit.corrected: Both layers flipped as matched pairs with ratings and whys rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text said to 'save E to dodge the W tether' and to 'cleanse' Focused Resolve; neither is supported. It also omitted the range relationship that decides the lane.
audit.why: Focused Resolve tethers at 675 and Spinning Slash reaches 650 — she can start the tether from outside your engage range. The tether breaks on distance or line of sight, so E is an exit tool, not a dodge. Cleanse/QSS eligibility is not in the kit data and is not asserted.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dosFull[0].d, spikes[1] and spikes[2] rewritten around the 650-vs-675 range gap, the 12s flat W cooldown, Mantra 40/38/36/34 shortened by Gathering Fire, and Grievous Wounds against the Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mocking Shout's back-turned condition was never stated.
audit.why: The 850-range AD cut applies to everyone; only enemies with backs turned are slowed — a Karma kiting away from your dive is exactly the case that triggers it.

edits.before: E lets you spin in and out of exchanges on your terms. Only take the trade when Karma's Focused Resolve is down.
edits.after: No dash yet and Inner Flame outranges you by 300. Heal the chip off with Bloodlust and give her nothing free.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Karma must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Spinning Slash is online at 650 range, but Focused Resolve tethers at 675 — she roots you before you reach her.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Focused Resolve's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Inner Flame drops to a 6-second cooldown here while Focused Resolve stays 12 — hold the wave near you and take only the windows between them.

edits.before: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds — dives and coin-flip all-ins become yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Karma's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds — a Mantra shield cannot outlast that, so this is the level you take the all-in and she has no answer for it.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Focused Resolve's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker helps, but Gathering Fire keeps Mantra near 36s and her shield covers her more often than not.

edits.before: Level 2 stays a skill test with neither champ able to commit decisively.
edits.after: Level 2 is hers — Inner Flame outranges you by 300 and you have no dash.

edits.before: At level 3 you pull ahead once E Spinning Slash lets you close on her squishy frame.
edits.after: Level 3 gives you Spinning Slash, but her 675-range tether roots you before you close.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay yours as you crit through her E shield faster than it regenerates.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 she pokes: Inner Flame falls to a 6s cooldown and Inspire shields the trade.

edits.before: Level 6 evens on paper since her R gives no escape, but the lane is already yours; marked skill for her Mantra timing.
edits.after: Level 6 is your window — Undying Rage makes 5 seconds of her damage irrelevant, and Mantra shields cannot stop a dive.

edits.before: At first item your crit-lifesteal build shreds her low defenses for a favoured all-in.
edits.after: At first item Gathering Fire keeps Mantra near 36s and her shield covers your all-in window.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Focused Resolve: 12s flat, a 675-range tether — spin out past 675 or behind terrain and the root never lands. - Mantra: 40/38/36/34, faster every spell she lands. - Undying Rage: 5s immunity, kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Karma's Focused Resolve: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. When it is down — Spin in, crit him down.
edits.after: Focused Resolve tethers at 675 — spin out of range or break sight and the root never lands. Mocking Shout slows only turned backs.

edits.before: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The tether roots at 675 — spin outside it or behind terrain and it breaks before the root lands.

edits.before: Karma gets no ultimate power spike (her R just upgrades an ability) so your level-6 Undying Rage lets you dive her freely; she can Mantra-E shield and W Focused Resolve root you, but if you save E to dodge the W tether you kill her through the shield.
edits.after: Mantra is hers from level 1, so level 6 only ranks it up — your Undying Rage is the real spike, and 5 seconds of immunity outlasts a Mantra-E shield. Save Spinning Slash to break her 675-range tether by leaving it, not to enter, and dive through the shield.

edits.before: You spike harder than Karma at first item: your crit-plus-lifesteal build shreds her low base defenses, and as long as you cleanse or outrange the W Focused Resolve root with Spinning Slash mobility, she has no way to survive your all-in.
edits.after: You spike hard at first item: crit plus lifesteal shreds her low base defenses, and Grievous Wounds matters here — a Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve heals her through a long trade. Break the tether by spinning out past 675 and she cannot survive the all-in.

edits.before: From level 3 you take over: E Spinning Slash lets you jump her fragile frame and crit her down faster than her E shield lasts, and level 6 changes nothing for her since Karma's R only empowers a spell rather than adding an escape.
edits.after: From level 3 Spinning Slash closes the 650 gap, but Focused Resolve tethers at 675 and roots you first — bait it, then jump. Level 6 is your swing: she has had Mantra since level 1, while Undying Rage is brand new.

edits.before: Post-first-item you stay ahead: your crit and lifesteal shred her low defenses, and as long as you respect the W Focused Resolve root you win every sidelane duel despite her team utility.
edits.after: Post-first-item you stay ahead: crit and lifesteal shred her low defenses, and Grievous Wounds cuts the Mantra-W heal. Break the 675 tether by spinning away and you win every sidelane duel.

edits.before: Dodge or outrange W Focused Resolve root before you commit
edits.after: Break the 675-range Focused Resolve tether by spinning out

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Focused Resolve and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Focused Resolve's 12-second cooldown and bait the tether.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Karma carry threat 6/10.
edits.after: Tricky matchup — difficulty 6/10, Karma carry threat 6/10.

notes: Conflict recorded, not resolved: the packet gives Tryndamere 53.46% over 2570 games, but the already-audited Karma page rates the lane FAVOURED for Karma (4/10) and gives her five of the seven chart rows. I followed the mirror so the two pages agree and mirror-fix has nothing to overwrite, but a 53.46% owner win rate sitting under a chart that Karma mostly wins will read oddly to a user. Cleanse/QSS against Focused Resolve is not asserted anywhere — the kit data does not carry it.
